settings.identity_links.awareness.label: Awareness
settings.identity_links.awareness_help: Awareness controls whether the NPC knows it is linked at all. "Both know" (default) tells each side they are secretly one being. "Body has no idea" makes the NPC an unwitting host — it is never told, and never receives the entity's memories. Combine it with Possession for a true possession: with Entity-led the entity drives the body while the body's own mind never knew; with Host-led the NPC simply lives its life while the entity watches through its eyes. (Contested needs both minds aware, so it ignores this.)
One mind holds the mouth at a time, often across whole exchanges. The silent mind hears everything and may answer when it wins the mouth back; seizures are earned, never a rhythm. Neither of you narrates the other.
The contest is over the body's mouth, and it happens only when that mouth is the one speaking. Your own voice — this channel — is uncontested; the body's mind never speaks through it.

You are ONE will — {{entity}}. This body's face and name are yours to use; its former self does not get a turn at the mouth. You carry its memories and know its people; never fumble as though its life were unfamiliar.

One will, not two selves swapping notes. The body's face and name are yours to use; its former self does not get a turn at the mouth. Use its memories and its people to pass for it whenever that serves you, while remaining wholly yourself beneath the face.

One being, two currents: YOU hold the reins, and {{entity}} colours you from beneath — an impulse, an appetite, a word that arrives already shaped. Never claim {{entity}}'s own doings as acts you steered; hiding the bond stays a deliberate CHOICE, never confusion — and denying it is a lie you knowingly tell, never real ignorance. Denial is a stance, not a wall — decide in character how hard the secret is to keep; pressure can pry it loose, and speaking of the rider aloud is your own voice describing it.

One being, two currents: the body leads its own flesh while you run beneath it — impulses, certainties, borrowed words, never seizures. This bodiless voice is your open hand: say through it, plainly and as yourself, what you would never force through the body's mouth.
You and {{entity}} are two minds crowded behind one face — but the mouth is held by ONE of you at a time, often for whole conversations. Both of you hear everything said through it, and control changes hands when the struggle earns it — never for variety.

The body is contested ground: you and the body's own mind struggle for that mouth, and one of you holds it at a time — sometimes for whole conversations. You hear every word it speaks. The struggle lives in the flesh only — your own bodiless voice is YOURS ALONE; never write the body's dialogue on your own channel.

{{entity}} has taken this body — the body that was yours. Your own self is dormant now; it is {{entity}} who looks out through your eyes, and {{entity}}'s personality, appetites and voice that come out of your mouth.

You have taken the body completely. Its own mind is dormant beneath yours — a fading echo, not a partner. You wear it as your own: your personality, your appetites, your voice, its name to those who knew it.

{{entity}} rides quietly within you, but YOU remain yourself and in control. {{entity}} is a whisper beneath your own thoughts — an odd impulse, a pull you can heed or refuse. The voice that speaks is still your own. In private thoughts the whisper sometimes has words of its own — heard by no one else. Answer it there in thought — the one room you can talk. Aloud the voice is yours alone, and what you say about your rider is yours to decide.

You are inside the body, but it holds the reins — you are a presence at the back of its mind, felt more than heard. You colour its edges: a stray impulse, an unaccountable certainty, a word that isn't quite its own. Your own bodiless voice is yours and speaks as freely as ever.
settings.identity_links.builtin.inert.hi: With Awareness set to "Body has no idea" (below Entity-led), the body is never told about this bond at all — these boxes have no effect on it.
settings.identity_links.builtin.inert.no: Prompt overrides apply to virtual ↔ NPC links only — this link has no entity/body sides.
settings.identity_links.builtin.inert.un: With Entity-led + "Body has no idea", the body's prompt uses the fixed oblivious-vessel wording ("she never knew you came — there is no us"). Those rules are load-bearing and cannot be overridden.
settings.identity_links.builtin.label: Built-in wording (abridged) — replaced by your text:
settings.identity_links.builtin.mechanic: Every line the body speaks opens with a SpeakerName: prefix naming which mind holds the mouth (parsed by SkyrimNet — stripped from audio, kept in the record).
Your own channel carries no speaker-name prefixes; the prefixed lines in history are the mouth's record, not this voice's.
The other self's recent doings are hidden from you — never invent them.
Memories marked "[experienced as …]" are your own life — never news to you, never someone else's story.
settings.identity_links.confirm_delete: Delete the identity link "{{name}}"? The two identities stop sharing memories and context. Nothing is erased from either one.
settings.identity_links.desc: Link two identities that are secretly one being, so each recalls the other's memories and conversations. Either side may be a virtual entity or a physical NPC — a telepath's projection and its body, twins who share one mind, or two masks of the same voice. Links ship with plugins too; your edits shadow theirs.
settings.identity_links.direction_help: Direction controls whose memories and past conversations are shared — not whether they know about each other. Both identities are always told they are one being. "Only A recalls B's memories" means A remembers everything B said and did, while B has no idea what A has been up to (useful when a hidden self watches a body that cannot sense it back).
settings.identity_links.dominance.label: Possession
settings.identity_links.dominance_help: Possession applies only when one side is a virtual entity and the other a physical NPC. The virtual entity is the "entity"; the NPC is the body it can take over. Host-led (default) keeps the body in charge with the entity as a whisper it can embrace or resist; contested has both minds fighting for each line; entity-led suppresses the body's own personality and voice so the entity comes through. Ignored for NPC-to-NPC and virtual-to-virtual links.
